notes: Covered by tests/test_skill_loader.py.

notes: Covered by tests/test_agent_harness_kernel.py.

notes: Covered by tests/test_agent_harness_kernel.py and tests/test_chat_api.py.

notes: Covered by query understanding, repo RAG, AgentLoop, and chat API tests.

notes: Covered by repo RAG and AgentLoop tests.

notes: Covered by tests/test_evidence_pack.py and related AgentLoop/API tests.

description: Bounded deterministic query rewrite and deterministic rerank before Evidence Pack.
notes: Covered by query rewrite, rerank, AgentLoop, and chat API tests.

description: Repo-local SQLite PREF/LTM, process-local STM, explicit memory commands, and internal memory audit.
acceptance_criteria: no vector memory or auto summary
notes: Covered by tests/test_memory.py and AgentLoop/API tests.

description: Repo-local Long Task control plane with pause/resume, scratch summaries, and ReAct trace skeleton.
acceptance_criteria: resume advances at most one step
no real subagents or worktree automation
notes: Covered by tests/test_long_task.py and AgentLoop/API tests.

description: Read-only Assistant Control Surface returns current capabilities, Memory counts, Long Task summary, and next commands through /chat.answer.
notes: V19 later allows audit.sqlite3 creation for all /chat requests while preserving no memory/task DB creation.

description: Safe Patch Authoring creates pending patch proposals from repo evidence and applies only after explicit confirmation.
notes: Covered by patch authoring, AgentLoop, and chat API tests.

description: Verification Runner executes fixed whitelisted pytest, ruff, or verify labels through ToolExecutor.
acceptance_criteria: rejects arbitrary shell and extra args
no persisted verification result in V17
notes: Covered by verification runner, AgentLoop, and chat API tests.

description: Patch + Verify Loop chains explicit pending patch apply and whitelisted verification in one confirmed flow.
acceptance_criteria: combined confirmation requires patch id and verification label
notes: Covered by patch authoring, verification runner, AgentLoop, and chat API tests.

description: Persistent Audit / Recovery records redacted audit summaries for all /chat requests and key patch, verification, and long task events, then serves read-only recovery through /chat.answer.
acceptance_criteria: no full diff/stdout/stderr/Evidence Pack/provider content/secrets/DB path/local absolute paths persisted
missing audit DB recovery query does not create state
audit write failure does not break primary /chat
recovery/status does not call repo_rag or mutate state
no new public API or /chat top-level fields; no automatic retention/pruning
notes: Covered by tests/test_persistent_audit.py, AgentLoop/API tests, full verify, and V19 Stage Debt Sweep evidence.

description: Confirmed patch flows create a controlled detached and locked Git worktree, then apply and optionally verify inside its internal execution path.
acceptance_criteria: standalone patch and combined Patch + Verify leave the main working tree unchanged
worktree_create requires valid confirmation context and clean non-bare Git repository preconditions
execution_repo_path remains internal and local absolute paths are not exposed or persisted
patch success transitions to applied_in_worktree and worktree lifecycle is persisted by user_id + repo_key
read-only worktree status queries do not call repo_rag or mutate repository files
no automatic worktree cleanup, commit, merge, push, promote, retry, or continuation
notes: Covered by tests/test_worktree_isolation.py, AgentLoop/API/audit tests, real Git worktree integration, and V20 validation evidence.

description: Read-only scoped worktree inventory and inspection with consistency checks and bounded redacted preview.
acceptance_criteria: inventory and inspection are isolated by user_id + repo_key and never create or modify state
preview paths come only from machine-readable fixed Git output; untracked files are count-only
preview rejects unsafe/binary content and enforces 20 files, 6000 total chars, 80 lines per file, and 300 chars per line
inventory and inspection skip persistent audit while retaining safe request-local trace
no re-verification, cleanup, reconciliation, promotion, main-workspace write, commit, merge, or push
no new public API or /chat top-level fields
notes: Implemented in ca8e299 and archived at openspec/changes/archive/2026-06-09-v21-worktree-inventory-inspection/; covered by targeted regression, full verify, OpenSpec validation, and Stage Debt Sweep evidence.

description: Explicit fail-closed re-verification of an existing scoped retained worktree using the existing verification whitelist and harness boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: only exact worktree re-verification commands with pytest, ruff, or verify are accepted
scope, directory, Git registry/path, and HEAD/base consistency are checked before execution
only patch_applied, verification_failed, or verification_succeeded worktree lifecycle states are eligible
verification runs only inside the retained worktree and the main workspace remains unchanged
executed results use verification_succeeded or verification_failed while patch remains applied_in_worktree
every recognized attempt produces a distinguishable redacted persistent audit result
no cleanup, reconciliation, promotion, patch mutation, arbitrary shell, new API, or /chat top-level fields
notes: Implemented in 30ae5a6 and archived at openspec/changes/archive/2026-06-14-v22-worktree-re-verification/; covered by targeted tests, adjacent regressions, full verify, OpenSpec validation, internal/external review, and Stage Debt Sweep evidence.

description: Explicit confirmed disposal and narrow fail-closed reconciliation of scoped retained worktrees.
acceptance_criteria: only exact confirmed discard and reconcile commands execute; discussion and malformed attempts do not fall through
scope, expected path, Git registry/path/lock, linked-worktree ownership, and HEAD/base are checked before destructive action
normal disposal and allowed reconciliation follow strict ordered idempotent lifecycle transitions
shared Git metadata reads enforce independent timeout and a hard output bound before content is read
patch closeout uses true no-create lookup and patch_id + user_id + repo_key scoped status update
every recognized attempt produces a redacted scoped persistent audit result
no promotion, patch mutation/reapply, implicit repair, automatic retry, prune, arbitrary shell, new API, or /chat top-level fields
notes: Implemented on feature/v23-worktree-disposal-reconciliation; covered by V23 targeted tests, adjacent V20-V22/patch-store/AgentLoop/API/audit regressions, OpenSpec validation, and Stage Debt Sweep evidence.
